title: 1899 Porto plague outbreak
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1899 Porto plague outbreak", at revision 1360830834, opens: "The 1899 Porto plague outbreak was an epidemic of bubonic plague centered in the city of Porto, in the north of Portugal." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q96360043, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "late 19th-century epidemic in Portugal". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
